computationalsciencelaboratory/fatode.manifest:
name = "fatode"
version = "0.0.0"
license = "GPL-3.0-only"
[library]
source-dir = "playground-library"
include-dir = ["src", "."]
[build]
auto-executables = false
auto-examples = false
auto-tests = false
[install]
library = true
[fortran]
implicit-typing = true
implicit-external = true
source-form = "default"

scope: Selected FATODE explicit Runge-Kutta tangent-linear integrator, linked to native BLAS/LAPACK. The FPM wrapper compiles unchanged TLM/ERK_TLM/ERK_TLM_f90_Integrator.F90; bundled precompiled platform binaries are not used. The example augments exponential decay with a constant rate state and differentiates the initial rate using the tangent-linear model, checking the state, rate, and both sensitivities against analytical formulas. It explicitly selects the supplied analytical Jacobian and enables tangent-variable adaptive error control; the initial default finite-difference Jacobian settings missed the requested sensitivity accuracy. No numerical library edits. Implicit/stiff solvers, adjoint integration, sparse solver variants and all ERK methods are not offered or verified.
